content.title: The SEA-IT / MDMA Study
content.provider: Metiv, under the supervision of Prof. Pinchas Dannon, Head of Psychiatry at Herzog Medical Center
content.who: People living with military-related PTSD who have previously taken part in trauma-focused therapy and whose symptoms persist, and who can commit to an intensive process of about 3.5 months.
content.what: A clinical study comparing two treatments: MDMA-assisted therapy, which combines taking the substance with psychotherapy, and SEA-IT, an intensive therapy focused on the body, experience and acceptance. 16 sessions over 3-3.5 months.
content.process: Fill out an online screening questionnaire. Eligibility for the study is determined through an assessment process, and it is not possible to choose between the two treatments.
content.note: This is a study: its purpose is to examine the two treatments. Taking part does not guarantee any outcome.

content.title: Interview Study: Returning to Combat
content.who: Combat soldiers who were living with military PTSD before the Iron Swords war and took part in the war.
content.what: An open interview about the experience of returning to combat.
